entities.summary: Isaiah Hassan Crowell is an American former professional football player who was a running back in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Georgia Bulldogs and Alabama State Hornets. Crowell was signed by the Cleveland Browns as an undrafted free agent in 2014.
